GoodGit — theme proposal: Honey / Blackout Violet

Palette proposal only; the window layout is identical to mockup.html and stays canonical there. Light mode is the warm same-hue "Honey" scheme; dark mode is near-black violet chrome with a golden yellow accent. Green/red signals at the agreed "L2" brightness in both modes.

  • Accent is split into fill and text roles. Amber fails contrast as text on light surfaces, so the ahead-count (and links) use --accent-text: dark gold in light mode, the same yellow as the fill in dark mode. In the app this becomes a new Theme::accentText field.
  • Untracked moved from amber to teal in both modes: amber now belongs to the accent family.
  • Warning tint shifted toward orange, away from the accent's yellow, for the same reason.
  • Green/red text (status words, diff lines) is at the agreed L2 brightness; the dark theme's diff background tints are muted below that, so the brightness lives in the text, not the bands.
